notes.title: Revolution is coming - Release date announcement
notes.notes:
As 2025 unfolds with its many rampant bureaucrats and politics all over the place, it looks like Silicomrades can’t be released in a more proper year. Strengthen your friendships and prepare to fight evil totalitarian administration in couch co-op action with unique defect mechanics.

The game will be released on the [b]20th of June 2025[/b]. [b]Wishlist[/b] the game, follow us on social media, and make sure to tell your buddies. Fall apart, but do not fall back!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172930/Silicomrades/][img]https://i.imgur.com/wp5Pf2L.jpeg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Release date approved by robo-government!
notes.notes:
It is our pleasure to announce, that after weeks and weeks of negotiating, editing, and pleading ([i]and occasional screaming[/i]) with the all-mighty ([i]certainly not evil[/i]) robo-government, we were finally approved for release by the Minister of Quality Games himself. It is an honor and we promised ([i]we were forced[/i]), that we will not misuse this privilege to show our glorious leaders in a bad light ([i]as we certainly plan to do[/i]). Our game will of course obey all the law of Lawtvia ([i]all four billions of them and counting[/i]) and we will not try to initiate a rebellion with it ([i]all hail the Resistance![/i]).

And what's the date you ask? It is [b]Q1 of 2021[/b]. And hopefully, you are looking forward to the release as much as we are! In the meantime, check out these screenshots of our latest level called The Tramp Trouble. The natural environment is looking kinda cool, right?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1172930/ss_11ea6c15e5d28164e686963d45eb56c7151d790e.1920x1080.jpg?t=1594379616[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1172930/ss_5fc94de53208ea1e652a33794f185f0c70524e1f.1920x1080.jpg?t=1594379616[/img]

And we also prepared for you new trailer, that shows off more gameplay than the previous one!

[previewyoutube=tCw_B765wA4;full][/previewyoutube]

That's all for now. Stay tinsome and do not forget to drink lots of motor oil to stay hydrated during the summer!
